args.title: Brightline returns logistics — combined summary
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.brightline.example/2026/returns and its companion piece (https://insights.brightline.example/returns/companion):

- Apparel return rates reached 24% in 2026, per Brightline's retail returns logistics analysis.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth (~20%).
- Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
